name: Reaper
caption: The owner of eV, who opens ReVolution #001 with a vision for the fed and the tournament, and who rules on it at will from the stage.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): opens the show, announces the Clayton Brothers' removal and the special matches for the next week, interrupts two matches and calls the main event a draw; the home page calls him the owner of eV.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on 7 other wing records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Nathan Paradine
caption: Won the opening Handicap Match of ReVolution #001 when the Clayton Brothers never arrived, and was promised a match he would not forget.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): awarded the opening handicap match by forfeit.

name: Michael Dredge
caption: A wrestler in a cowboy outfit who arrives late, refuses to share a dressing room and fights MJ to a draw in a Hangman's Horror match; he and the owner once 'ran together'.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): the 'Old Friends' scene and the main event, a Hangman's Horror match with MJ; the home page names him as one half of a match that went to a no contest. The announced card of 24 August 2008 and the home page name the same wrestlers in a continuing storyline.

name: Kale Forne
caption: Fought Nanu in a tournament match that Peter Gilmour broke up, and was beaten with a chair afterwards.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): a tournament match against Nanu, ended by Peter Gilmour's attack.

name: Nanu
caption: Fought Kale Forne in a tournament match that Peter Gilmour broke up; his arm was left 'hanging from his body'.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): a tournament match against Kale Forne, ended by Peter Gilmour's attack.

name: Peter Gilmour
caption: Calls himself the Xtreme Icon, a former world champion and three-time hardcore champion from the sVo, who burned his mask there and, with Rose Smith at his side, beat Joseph Equinox on the night and declared himself the future eV champion.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): attacks Nanu and Kale Forne, is interviewed, and beats Joseph Equinox in a tournament match; the home page says he wants the eV Championship. The announced card of 24 August 2008 and the home page name the same wrestlers in a continuing storyline.

identity.note: CHZ's 2002 Xtreme Icon is a different wrestler billed under that nickname (a CHZ Television Title tournament semi-finalist); nothing ties him to this Peter Gilmour beyond the billing.

name: Joseph Equinox
caption: A former sVo champion who was jumped on the stage by Peter Gilmour and lost their tournament match.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): the opponent in Peter Gilmour's tournament match and interview ('Nox' elsewhere on the page).

name: Lucas Newman
caption: The head interviewer of eV, who talks to Peter Gilmour before his tournament match.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): the 'Bitter Enemies' interview.

name: Rose Smith
caption: Peter Gilmour's girlfriend, who rides with him to the interview and kisses the camera.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): appears beside Peter Gilmour in the 'Bitter Enemies' interview, named as his girlfriend.

name: TJ Raven
caption: Won a tournament match over Howie Banks at ReVolution #001, a night when the owner then attacked his beaten opponent.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): wins a tournament match over Howie Banks.

name: Howie Banks
caption: Lost to TJ Raven and was beaten by the owner, who told him he would face a special match the next week, and that losing it would have 'the ultimate consequence'.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): loses a tournament match to TJ Raven and is attacked afterwards by Reaper.

name: MJ
caption: A young wrestler who tells a story in a locker room and draws with Michael Dredge in a Hangman's Horror match.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): the 'Wanna Hear A Story' scene and the main event against Michael Dredge. The announced card of 24 August 2008 and the home page name the same wrestlers in a continuing storyline.

name: Travis Williams
caption: Beat Steven Steel by Fujiwara armbar in a tournament match; the home page names him among the men Peter Gilmour has to beat.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): the 'Wanna Hear A Story' scene and a tournament win over Steven Steel.

name: Steven Steel
caption: Lost to Travis Williams when he tapped to a Fujiwara armbar after hitting a corner pole with his shoulder.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): loses a tournament match to Travis Williams (the page spells his name Steele in one scene).

name: KVT
caption: A wrestler who failed to show for her tournament match with Talon, which the owner then called a lack of courtesy and set a special match for the next week.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): scheduled against Talon, did not show; the home page names her. The announced card of 24 August 2008 and the home page name the same wrestlers in a continuing storyline.

name: Talon
caption: Won by default against KVT, talked back to the owner, and is told in the fed's home page news to face a gauntlet of seven opponents.

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): awarded the match against KVT; the home page says he must run a gauntlet at ReVolution as a punishment. The announced card of 24 August 2008 and the home page name the same wrestlers in a continuing storyline.
